title: ZIONISM IN THE FACE OF SYRIA & HEZBOLLAH

sense.text:
“The Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord.” Back in ancient times that cruel lord was Nebuchadnezzar. But it is written without his name on purpose, because it reaches forward to the prophecies of this last kingdom, the fourth kingdom, today. “A fierce king shall rule over them”: we are seeing that today.

What the world now calls the Middle East is a Eurocentric term, coined in 1902 by an American strategist to serve British imperial interests. When people hear it they think Arabs or white folks, never black people, though black people are clearly there. That is why they say Jesus came from the Middle East.

“The waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.” The rivers turned far away, the brooks emptied, the reeds and flags withering, “every thing sown by the brooks” driven away: everything around these waterways is going to be affected in these last days. We are seeing it now with the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran taking control of it.
The fishers mourn, they that cast angle and spread nets languish, and they that work in fine flax and weave networks are confounded. The whole livelihood that hangs on the waters is struck.

“All that make sluices and ponds for fish.” A sluice is an artificial, narrow channel with a sliding gate, used to control the flow of water and the levels of a canal. These are the man-made waterways.

That is exactly what the nations are scrambling over now. With Iran holding the Strait of Hormuz, Newt Gingrich's solution is to set off a dozen thermonuclear detonations and cut a new channel through friendly territory, wider than the Panama Canal and deeper than the Suez. Those are the artificial channels of Isaiah 19.

The Suez Canal itself is a man-made waterway in Egypt, opened in 1869, joining the Mediterranean to the Red Sea and separating Africa from Asia. It was built so the ships of Europe would not have to go all the way around Africa. It carries the oil to Europe and is vital to America's military, which is why the West has always fought to control it. When Gamal Abdel Nasser nationalized it in 1956, Britain, France and Israel attacked Egypt. Nasser is the same man who said the Jews left black and came back white, and who went to war against those fake Israelis in the Six-Day War, until America and Britain stepped in. Isaiah saw these waterways and all who live by them broken in these last days.

“Set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it.” Mount Seir is Esau, Edom, so prophesying against Mount Seir is prophesying against Edom. Today Mount Seir is called Petra, and the Arabs, the Nabataeans, took it over around the third or fourth century. But the scriptures are speaking of Esau. This chapter is not a prophecy against the Arabs; it is about Esau.

“Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate. I will lay thy cities waste.” God is against Esau, the white man, and means to make him desolate.

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end.” Any time our iniquity had an end and we thought we would be all right, Mount Seir, Esau, came in behind us.

The Emancipation Proclamation said, you blacks are free. We started to build, and Esau terrorized us: the Ku Klux Klan, Jim Crow, the black codes. They said, y'all living better than us white folks. They bombed our homes, took our properties, and they are living in them today, and nobody will talk about it. Some of them they flooded, especially in Atlanta.

Then they tell us, if you don't like it here, go back to Africa, while they are robbing Africa. We did not come here of our own free will; they dragged us here and used us. And they do not really want us to leave: during World War II, when blacks wanted to fly to help Ethiopia fight Mussolini, America made laws forbidding them to get on the planes.

“I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood.” Esau is a bloody race. It goes back to Genesis 25, when Esau begged for that same red pottage: what was in it was raw meat. They love blood.

“Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate.” This is a prophecy of the destruction of Esau, Edom, which has not happened yet. “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”: that is how we know, because their cities are still standing today.

“These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there.” The two nations are the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel. The two countries are the land of Israel and America, North America.

Where the Lord was there, Esau took both. In 1948 one group took the land as Jews: Judah means praise of God, and they said, we are the praise of God. In 1776 the other group took the Americas as Christians, saying, we are the anointed ones of God.

Even their own say it: Israel is crazy white people of Eastern European extraction who founded a colony in the Middle East and said the Bible promises it to them, armed to the teeth with US money. When we say that, they call us racist; when the white man says it about his own people, nobody argues.

precepts.why: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” This is how Mount Seir is identified. Esau is Edom, and Esau dwelt in Mount Seir, so every prophecy against Mount Seir is a prophecy against Esau, Edom, and not against the Arabs who later took over the place.

sense.text:
“Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man.” If you don't know who the evil man is today, we can't help you. The evil man is not Pookie and Ray Ray. It is the major evil in the earth, the so-called white man.

The violent man is the one dropping bombs, murdering thousands in one stroke; you don't get more violent than that. Little girls killed in Iran, children killed, people starved, economies destroyed, crops and the ozone layer destroyed, fake food, child trafficking, the leaders of the earth on an island raping women and having sex with children, killing people, eating people. Never shut down when they say, what about black on black crime. Black on black crime does not compare to what they are doing. And don't fall for the Amalek on social media crying that Iran hit a school; they want you to forget the girls they murdered and what they did in Gaza. They said the Palestinians cut off babies' heads and never showed proof; even caught in the lie, they would not take it back. All propaganda.
“Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.” For war, always war.

“They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent”: that is their media. What they say is always destructive to every other race. “Adders’ poison is under their lips”: their philosophies, their religions, their politics. “Selah” means it is true.
“Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.” The one whose goings they purpose to overthrow is the Israelites.

What would Jesus say about the violent man? “The kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.” Is somebody jumping up into the sky punching God in the face? No. The kingdom of heaven is the nation of Israel, and it suffers violence at the hands of Rome.

The violent who take it by force are Rome, the same violent man we just read in Psalms 140. Christ called Rome the violent man, and it is the same man being violent to us today.

Even the numbers they told about the Holocaust come apart in their own mouths: a New York rabbi says not even three million, not even one million Jews were killed, the rest being intermarried and not Jewish. That is from his mouth, not ours.

precepts.why: David speaks: “he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.” Israel is called the kingdom of the Lord. So when Christ says the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, he is speaking of the nation of Israel, God's kingdom on earth, suffering violence from Rome, not of anything happening in the sky.

sense.text:
“But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” The wicked here is the same violent man and evil man we have been reading. The wicked is Edom.

One group of Esau took the new covenant as Christians and took the land of America. The other group, in 1948, took the old covenant as Jewish people and said, we are the Jews. God asks them what right they have to declare his statutes or take his covenant in their mouth.
“Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.” Whether they call themselves Jewish or Christian, they hate instruction and cast God's words behind them.

precepts.why:
“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places.” Edom is Esau, Mount Seir, the same subject. God says “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness.” That is the name for the wicked: Edom.

And “The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” The people, not the person. The apologetics like to play word games and say it is talking about the one man Esau, but people is plural: it means all of them. And for how long? For ever. So when Psalms 50 says “unto the wicked”, read it, unto Edom.

“Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there.” The two nations are the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel; the two countries are Israel and America.

They took America as Christians and the land of Israel as Jewish people. That is what Psalms 50 means by Edom taking God's covenant in his mouth: the one took the new covenant, the other the old, and both are Esau.

sense.text: “Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation?” They set themselves up as the congregation of the Lord. “Do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?”
“Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.”
“The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” God says that when these people are born, they are wicked, and from birth they go about speaking lies.

“Their poison is like the poison of a serpent”: their religions and their politics are the poison of a serpent. “They are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear”: they cannot hear our cries. You try to reason with them and they say, we had you in slavery? Reparations? Really?

“Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.” Our people are the charmers, trying to charm the white man with rationale. Ghana goes to the UN and says, you owe black Americans reparations; America says no, Israel says no, Argentina says no. They do not want to hear anything.

God does not care how eloquently you speak. You might have the best vernacular in the world and all the historic facts and documentation; they will not hearken, charming never so wisely.

So the Bible gives the only solution: “Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.” That is what the Bible says. You are trying to charm them with eloquent talk and reason with them, and God says no: the only solution is to bust them in their mouth.

precepts.why:
“They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.” Any time you speak truth to power, especially the word of God, they will hate you and despise you.

Stokely Carmichael, who changed his name to Kwame Ture, is the example. He began with Martin Luther King in the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee, got tired of the nonviolent thing and getting hit upside the head, and joined the Black Panther Party as its honorary Prime Minister, then led the All-African People's Revolutionary Party. Back in the '60s he said plainly that Zionism is a political philosophy, not religion, made to confuse people into thinking Zionism and Judaism are one; that Africa gave Judaism to the world and the first Jews were Africans; that Theodor Herzl, who founded Zionism in Basel in 1897, was an atheist, so how could a man who does not believe in God find the state God promised his chosen people? He called Zionism satanic, imperialist and racist, taking the Palestinians' land by terror while America sends Israel billions and leaves its own homeless. He knew, and they hated him for speaking uprightly.

The white man's own books bear him out. An atlas of Africa printed in 1714 says Judaism was the religion of the ancient Africans for a long time, followed by Christianity, until the Muslims put the Jews, Christians and professors of the African religion to death and burned their books, because those books led them to condemn Muhammad's law. Today the Zionists use Judaism to justify their expansion, framing the state of Israel as the fulfilment of prophecy so they can take everybody's land for a greater Israel.

sense.text:
“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth”: this is America. “And he had two horns like a lamb”: the bipartisan system, Republicans and Democrats. Like a lamb because they say they are Christian; they say America is a Christian nation.

“And he spake as a dragon.” Trump says we have to bring religion back and bring God back into our lives. But their god is not the God of the Bible. He supports the Israelis who follow the Talmud, which allows pedophilia and the worship of Molech, and that tells you America's god is not the God of the Bible, whatever they say.

Then listen to his right-hand man announce Operation Epic Fury: if you kill Americans or threaten Americans anywhere on earth, we will hunt you down without apology and without hesitation, and we will kill you. That is dragon talk. America sends spies into your country to destabilize you, the way the movie Argo shows, and when you retaliate, it declares it will kill you. Even the 47th president after 47 years is symbolism they are putting out.

“And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them.” This is when the white man came and started to take over lands and countries, beginning around 1492. “They shall deride every strong hold”: the conquistadors. “For they shall heap dust, and take it”: heaping dust means confusion. They brought religion, and they took the land.

“Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend.” His mind changes: I want to be a more democratic white guy, I want to be nice to the people I conquered. But he is still offending.

“Imputing this his power unto his god.” His god with a little g is not the God of the Bible. He serves a different god than we do, and he has fooled the world into thinking he serves the God of the Bible. He does not.

“And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god.” The Greeks did this, Rome did this, and America has done the same thing. He “shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods”, and he shall prosper until it is accomplished.

“Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.” He does not desire women, and he magnifies himself above all gods.
“But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces”: the god of weaponry, the god of destruction. And “a god whom his fathers knew not” he honours with gold, silver and precious stones.

“Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god.” “He shall cause them to rule over many”: his people, his lieutenants, his generals. “And shall divide the land for gain”: when Alexander died, his four top generals divided up the land, and the white man did the same thing in the 1800s at the Berlin Conference, when they divided up Africa for gain.

precepts.why:
What Daniel prophesied in 11:36 is recorded again here: “Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped.” To oppose means to go against.

“So that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” His temples are taken for the temples of God, and all his images show him as God: him as the son of God, him as the angels, him as the Jews. What we read in 2 Thessalonians 2 is the same thing Daniel prophesied the white man would do.

The book In the Pillory, The Tale of the Borgia Pope, gives the open secret: Cesare Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander, posed for the image of Jesus, with the crown of thorns and thin hair, called Salvator, the Spanish for saviour. He set himself up as God in the temple of God.

“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached.” Who came preaching another Jesus? That picture is another Jesus. You will not find one scripture describing Jesus like that.

“Or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received”: with the new Jesus comes another spirit, an antichrist spirit. “Or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”: and another gospel. Black Christians love to say it doesn't matter what he looks like, what matters is his message. But Paul says what comes with another Jesus is another gospel.

The apostles never taught or accepted a gospel where all races come together in the name of a white Jesus. That is not in the Bible.

sense.text: “The eagle rose upon her talons, and spake to her feathers.” The eagle with the twelve feathers represents the white man, Esau, Edom, and in particular America in his last days. It starts with Rome, and America ends it.
“Watch not all at once: sleep every one in his own place, and watch by course: But let the heads be preserved for the last.” The three heads are kept for the last, and one of those heads is America.

“And I beheld, and, lo, the voice went not out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.” When Ezra heard the eagle speak, the voice was not coming from the heads but from the midst of the body. That is what President Assad of Syria was saying: the American president is only a performer, not the decision maker; the deep state behind him dictates what he does, and it accepts no partners in the world, only puppets, followers and proxies. Putin has said the same, but black people are not listening.

Y'all look at Trump like he is the guy. He is a figurehead, a manager. Barack Obama secretly bombed seven countries; Trump bombed eight. It is the billionaires and trillionaires behind the administration calling the shots, never the man sitting in the seat. And in the Middle East, Israel wants to be the superpower the way America is in the West, so every government there has to be a puppet: that is why Syria, why Iran, and next Saudi Arabia and Turkey. For greater Israel to work there can be no strong government anywhere around it.

precepts.why:
This goes with the voice that came not from the eagle's heads but from its body, what they call the deep state. “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”: you think you are fighting against Trump? You are not.

“But against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” Look at their own pyramid of power: the all-seeing Luciferian eye at the top, the same eye on the dollar bill, then the council of the richest families, the think tanks, the Council on Foreign Relations, the United Nations, the Bilderberg Group, the Club of Rome, the IMF, the World Bank and the central banks, with religion, government, education and the media all added to the control. At the bottom are the sheep: that is us.

They work with spirits and with demons; the whole system is set up in a demonic way. That is why black men and women who say they will go into the government and change things have never succeeded. Only God can destroy all that sits above us.

sense.text: “A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.” Trump says we are having good negotiations with Iran; Iran says that is a lie, there have been no talks at all. The liars shall not escape.
“The burden of the desert of the sea.” We are talking about desert lands: “it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.”

“The treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously.” America is the treacherous dealer: it says one thing and does another. They called Iran to peace talks, not once but twice, and while the talks were on, they bombed Iran. You called me here for peace talks and now you are bombing my country.

“And the spoiler spoileth”: the spoiler is a robber. They robbed Venezuela's oil and said, it's mine now, and they want to do the same with Iran.

“Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media.” Elam is the biblical name for the people of Iran, Pakistan and India, and the Kurds as well. When God raises up Media and Elam against this treacherous dealer, “all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.” That is why Iran is saying, you want to fight? Come. We have been waiting on this all our life. Trump paused his strikes and claimed there were talks, while Iran mocked America and said there are no talks and the United States has been defeated.

“Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.” Do not follow their religions, their politics, their customs, their traditions. “Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.”

“For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.” These people do not get a good night's sleep unless they do some evil to somebody. That is what the Bible says about them. Y'all keep thinking you can change them. Have they changed in 400 years? There is always a black man or black woman who says, I can change them. It has been 400 years.

“For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.” Their food and drink is wickedness and violence; they live off it. That is how God created them, and you cannot undo it or change it.

“Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea.” Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. So there should be no confusion: this verse names the race that would take the land of Israel.

“Which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds.” They took the land knowing they are not the Jews, knowing they are the devil. “To cast it out for a prey”: they called to all their European friends, the Caucasians in Uzbekistan, Poland, Germany, Russia, Ukraine and Czechoslovakia, and said, come get a part of this land.

The history bears it out. President Assad of Syria said the Jews who came to Palestine are Khazars from east of the Caspian Sea, pagans who converted in the eighth century and have nothing to do with the ancient people of Israel, and that is part of why they wanted him out. The book The Roman Empire, the Empire of the Edomite (1853) records King Bulan of the Khazars choosing Talmudism, now called Judaism, as the state religion, he and his four thousand nobles converted by rabbis brought from Babylonia; and those rabbis were our people, brought over there to convert them. The converted Khazars were the first self-styled Jews of Eastern Europe. Arthur Koestler wrote in The Thirteenth Tribe that their ancestors came not from the Jordan but from the Volga, not from Canaan but from the Caucasus, and called it the most cruel hoax history has ever perpetrated: Caucasians stealing the identity of the true Jews. We were teaching this in 1990, before social media. White people write it in their own books, and y'all argue with us instead. The Bible is our proof.

“When the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.” We defiled our land by our own ways. Like a menstruous woman: that is how disgusted God was with us, and he had to remove us out of the land.
“Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it.”

“And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries.” This is what would happen to the real twelve tribes. “According to their way and according to their doings I judged them.”

“And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord.” How did we profane God's holy name? When we got among the heathen we started saying, y'all are the Jews now, we're not the Jews. We started calling the white man the Jews.

That is the prophecy of what is going on today: the real black Jews saying to the white man, y'all are the Jews, y'all are God's chosen people.

precepts.why:
“These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there.” The kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel; the land of Israel and America. We will take it, we will steal it.

They took the land of Israel as Jews on that side of the world, and on this side they took this land as Christians. Ezekiel 36:5 then names who did it: Idumea, Edom.

“To the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad.” James writes to the twelve tribes scattered abroad, just as Ezekiel says God scattered them among the heathen and dispersed them through the countries. A Christian ought to be able to understand this: the twelve tribes are the ones scattered abroad.

sense.text: “The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy.” The murderer is the same evil man, the same violent man, the same wicked man we have been reading about all day. He kills all people. “And in the night is as a thief”: he steals, he takes.

“The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.” This murderer is also an adulterer. He disguises his face as Jews, as Christians, as Jesus, as God. And people say, surely it can't be them; they would never do wickedness, these are God's chosen people, these are the people of Jesus. They would believe Pookie and Ray Ray did it before they believe the white man did.

“In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime.” They mark homes. You see it in Palestine today: one says, you are stealing my home, and the settler says, if I don't steal it, somebody else is going to, so it's better that I steal it.

“They know not the light”: they do not know God's light, the truth.

“For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death”: they are like vampires. “If one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.” If you realize these are the people God hates, the terrors come. That is why the leaders who bring out that they are not the real Jews disappear or die; there is a curse, something happens to them. We are the last ones standing.

“In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.” The children of Israel were moved out of the land.

“Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength.” We forgot the God of our salvation, and we have never been mindful of the rock of our strength.

“Therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips.” A slip is a cutting from a plant, a branch or twig. Strange slips are strange branches: Esau. They are strange; they are not the people of the book, not the people of the covenant, and God says they would be set in the land.

precepts.why:
Christ said the same thing about strange slips coming into the land. “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword”: the real Israelites would fall by the edge of Rome's sword. “And shall be led away captive into all nations”: captive means slaves.

“And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.” Christ is telling you the Gentiles were going to take over the land. That is what Isaiah calls the strange slips, the strange people who would take the land.

“Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses.” God calls them the worst of the heathen, and they possess our houses. They are the Gentiles Christ spoke of in Luke 21:24, the strange slips of Isaiah 17.

“I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled. Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none. Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour.”

sense.text:
“Also that, whom they would help to a kingdom, those reign; and whom again they would, they displace: finally, that they were greatly exalted.” This is where America got the idea of coups, of destabilizing countries. Whom they want to make president or leader, those reign; whom they don't like, for his politics or his religion, they move out of the way.

Look at Syria. Bashar al-Assad was saying, you are not even real Jews, you should not even be in the land, so they said, get rid of him. Rebel forces need money and weapons, and they get them from America, Britain, France or Israel; it is always one of these Europeans, which is why their own book says the cause of all the world's problems is Caucasoid behavior. The man they put in, Ahmed al-Sharaa, Abu Muhammad al-Julani, was a rebel commander who joined al-Qaeda in Iraq, led al-Nusra Front and Hayat Tahrir al-Sham, and had a ten-million-dollar bounty on his head. Now they cleaned him up, gave him a haircut, and Donald Trump shakes his hand in the White House. Stop listening to American propaganda.

That is how they do it: two or three hundred disgruntled people out of a country of millions, given money and promises, like Trump telling the people of Iran to overthrow their government. It is the same thing we are reading in Maccabees. And it is why the leadership here guards itself: if they will send criminals into other countries, they will send them into this movement too, pretending to repent and biding their time to move up and start trouble.

This is an article of their policy, how they support the ones they put in. Judas Maccabeus was catching so much hell from the Greeks that he went to Rome for help, and this is what Rome told him: “If there come first any war upon the Romans or any of their confederates throughout all their dominion, The people of the Jews shall help them.” What Rome said here is what America does today.

“Neither shall they give any thing unto them that make war upon them, or aid them with victuals, weapons, money, or ships, as it hath seemed good unto the Romans.” No food, no weapons, no money, no ships: today that is called sanctions. That is why they cut off Cuba and forbid every country to help it, and why America told the Caribbean, get rid of all the Cuban doctors or we cut off your food supply. America supplies a great part of the Caribbean's food, so they all complied.

“In the same manner also, if war come first upon the nation of the Jews, the Romans shall help them with all their heart.” America will help you with all their heart, and nothing will be given to those that take part against you: “they shall keep their covenants, and that without deceit.” “According to these articles did the Romans make a covenant with the people of the Jews.” It is the same today: America makes articles like these with countries. This is where they got it from.

“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city.” The dead bodies are the Israelites, spiritually dead. “Which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt”: this is not the real Sodom nor the real Egypt, but a spiritual Sodom and a spiritual Egypt. America is seen as Egypt many times in the Bible.

Look at the dollar bill: that all-seeing eye is the same eye on top of the pyramid of how the system is set up. Satan deals with this system.
“As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” Now they put out videos saying in the Hebrew hate means love less. Such malarkey.
“Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.” God is not unrighteous.
“I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.”

“So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.” You cannot will yourself to be the people of God, and you cannot run around setting up churches to be the people of God. It is God that shows mercy.

“For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up.” Paul is comparing Esau with Pharaoh. At the time he wrote, the ruling power was Rome, and he could not openly condemn Rome, so he compares Esau to Pharaoh. Rome was raised up in power then, and today America is an extension of Rome, the world superpower; you don't get more powerful.

“That I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.” The way God raised Pharaoh up, he raised Rome up, and he raised America up, so that he could show his power. The Lord is not going to have another nation take America down, just as with Rome and Pharaoh. He lets them get all their technological advances, then he flexes and shows the whole world he is the only one who can take them down.

precepts.why: “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land.” This is the mercy Romans 9 speaks of: it is not of him that wills or runs, but of God. God said he will set Israel in their own land. Not the League of Nations, not the UN, not America. God.

sense.text: “Against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.” In chapter 46 Nebuchadnezzar wipes Egypt out, yet here Jeremiah takes it back to a Pharaoh smiting Gaza, and that gives pause. The ancient name for Palestine is Philistine. This Pharaoh, the same one we read about in Romans 9 and the spiritual Egypt of Revelation 11, goes into Esau: before that Esau smote Gaza.
“Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood.” It shall overflow the land, the city and them that dwell therein, and the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
“The fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands.” Imagine so much devastation, so much war and destruction, that a father cannot go back to help his own children.

“Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines”: that is Palestine today. “And to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon”: write this down, Tyrus and Zidon is modern-day Lebanon. Israel has announced it will occupy southern Lebanon up to the Litani River to stop Hezbollah, and it is striking Lebanon now.

“Every helper that remaineth”: everybody that tries to help Lebanon and the Palestinians. Every helper refers to every group they designate as a terror group. Hezbollah was created in 1982 to fight the Israeli invasion of Lebanon; it did not exist until Israel started invading the country, though the media will make you think it is just some evil terrorist group. Written off after Israel killed its chief in 2024, it was rebuilt by Iran and opened a second front on Israel when America and Israel struck Iran in 2026. In Syria the helpers are the list of terror groups that fight under or beside Hayat Tahrir al-Sham. All the helpers shall be cut off.

“Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley.” Baldness means destruction. On the map, Ashkelon sits just above Gaza, and Ashkelon today is suffering heavy casualties.

“How long wilt thou cut thyself?” That is tatbir: Muslims cutting themselves in their prayers to their god, wanting help and mercy against their enemies, much like some Catholics who punish themselves.
“O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.” The sword of the Lord is the white man.

“How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” The sword cannot be quiet: God appointed it to bring destruction on those lands, Gaza and the sea shore over there.

precepts.why:
Among these Arab nations are princes, the crown princes of Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain. “Woe to the world and them that dwell therein! For the sword and their destruction draweth nigh, and one people shall stand up to fight against another.” If you didn't realize it, we are living this today.

“For there shall be sedition among men”: sedition means insurrection against the government. “They shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.” There is going to be a revolt against these princes, because they are in bed with America and Israel, while the masses under them say, what are you doing? We are supposed to help our fellow Muslim.

“A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation.” Some of you are very comfortable in America and think it could never happen here. We see the lack already in India, the Philippines and China, which went to a four-day week over the Strait of Hormuz. America loves the negro only so far; when it runs short, it will be enough only for white people. Store up your food, non-perishables, not cookies, bonbons and bread you will have to throw out at Passover. Stop being so damn dumb. When the bread runs short, your unbelieving neighbours and family will be kicking at your door because they know you have food.

“Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus.” The south is Africa and Arabia; Libanus is Lebanon, so Lebanon is not out of the picture. They turn “one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them.” Them is us.

“Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom.” That is why it is so important: God is causing these wars to destroy them because of what they have been doing to us Israelites. We have a just and almighty God, and this is the big payback. He is coming for you, to save you, and you are feeling sorry for the people that destroyed us.

What is the sword of the Lord? “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword.” The wicked is God's sword, and “From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure.”

So when Jeremiah cries “O thou sword of the Lord”, the sword is the wicked, the white man, whom God uses as his sword and his hand.

There hath he appointed it: Gaza and those places along the sea shore. Then Jeremiah turns to Syria: “Concerning Damascus”: Damascus is Syria, and Hamath and Arpad are cities there; it is all Syria. “They have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.”

“Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her.” “How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!” Remember, Lebanon at one time belonged to the twelve tribes. “Her young men shall fall in her streets”, and God will “kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad.”

The things the Bible recorded historically are reoccurring events. Damascus has fallen, the palaces opened to the public, and the new president of Syria is a man who used to work for al-Qaeda.

sense.text: “The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof”: this is Syria. “When the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord”: all the eyes of Israel, our people, turned toward the Lord. We have to put our attention toward the Lord.

“And Hamath also shall border thereby”: that is Syria. “Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise”: that is Lebanon. They were a merchant city, very wise. But examine it today: America is the one with bases all around that area, so the very wise Tyrus over there is actually America.
“And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.”

“Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.” Tyre and Zidon here are America's bases over there, and they are going to be wiped out. As of March 2026 the US keeps 40,000 to 50,000 troops in the region to deter Iran and Hezbollah, and while not heavily stationed inside Lebanon, its forces operate nearby. America is operating over there.

“Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed.” “The king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.” Ashkelon, where the Israelis are, shall not be inhabited.

“And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod.” On the map, Ashdod is right above Ashkelon. When we say it, you think we are being racist, but this is what the Bible says: God calls them in Ashdod bastards. “And I will cut off the pride of the Philistines”: the Philistines refers to Palestine.

“And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth.” This is an abomination between the teeth: in the ultra-Orthodox ritual of metzitzah b'peh, after the foreskin is removed, the one performing it puts his mouth over the baby's wound and sucks the blood, and infants in New York have caught herpes from it and died. These bastards in Ashdod suck the blood from the baby's penis. That is why we had to bring receipts.

One who watches them called Israel a militarized vampire nation, living on death, destruction and blood. Now look at Dracula and you know it's about them. The Most High is exposing them: the Epstein files tell of babies dismembered, and in the tunnels under Brooklyn they found a bloody mattress, baby clothes and baby food, as on Epstein's island they found baby clothes, toys and coloring books.

“But he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God”: that is you and I. “And he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.” Ekron, on the map above Jerusalem, shall be as a Jebusite: our servants.

“And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more.” No oppressor shall oppress us anymore. “For now have I seen with mine eyes”: God has seen, to have respect unto us.

“Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee.” We have to believe: our King comes unto us. “He is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.” And they say Christ is not mentioned in the Old Testament.

“And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off”: we would have no military during this time. “And he shall speak peace unto the heathen.”

“And his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.” They are scared of the saying, from the river to the sea; well, it is in the Bible too. And it is not just that little area: from sea to sea and from the river to the ends of the earth, the whole earth. When we went into the land the Lord gave us that portion according to the number of the children of Israel, but the whole earth really belongs to us.

“As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.” If you didn't know it, this is the pit, the valley of the shadow of death; Ezekiel 37 calls America the valley of dry bones. “Wherein is no water”: there is no truth here.

“Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope.” We are the prisoners of hope, and the stronghold is the Lord, this Bible. “Even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee.”

Write down the chain of events: the awakening, which is us waking up; then the tribulation, and we are between the two now; World War III; Armageddon in the midst of that war, where Christ makes his advent; then deliverance, the wilderness, and kings and priests in rulership.

precepts.why: “O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.” This is what we say to the Lord, and it is the wording of Zechariah 9:1: the eyes of all the tribes of Israel toward the Lord. Keep our eyes on the Lord.

What goes with the Lord smiting Tyrus? “Concerning Damascus”: that is Syria. “They have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet. Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.”

These are the things that are going to happen, and have happened already in Syria.

Before Zechariah's “blood out of his mouth”, the scripture about blood: “whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.” That includes those who come from Santo Domingo: do not eat blood sausage, what some call black sausage.

“For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls.” “No soul of you shall eat blood.” The hunter must “pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.” “Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.” So when God takes away the blood out of his mouth, it is the people who eat and suck blood.

This is about Esau: “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity.” “I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.”

Esau has not hated blood. He is the one with blood in his mouth in Zechariah 9:7, the vampire nation.

To understand “Ekron as a Jebusite”: “Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain.” “So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David.” When you read the history, David smote the Jebusites and made them servants.

“And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel”, those left in the land, “upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.” They were our servants, our slaves.

So when Zechariah 9:7 says “Ekron as a Jebusite”, it is saying they are going to be our servants.

“Now have I seen with mine eyes” goes back to Egypt: “And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.” As God saw us in Egypt and had respect unto us, so he sees us now, and no oppressor shall pass through us any more.

To show the history of what Zechariah was prophesying: “they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.” “And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.”

That is the King of Zechariah 9:9, lowly and riding upon a colt the foal of an ass. To those who say Christ is not mentioned in the Old Testament: shut up, you don't know what you're talking about.

“He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth. They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.” The same dominion Zechariah gives the King: from sea to sea, from the river to the ends of the earth.

What is the blood of thy covenant? “Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant.” The blood of the everlasting covenant is Christ dying on the cross. By that blood God sends forth the prisoners out of the pit.

The stronghold: “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” The Lord is the stronghold, and so it means this Bible. Turn to it, ye prisoners of hope.

Zechariah says turn you to the stronghold; Proverbs says “Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.” God's reproof is his laws. So there is a stipulation to receive God's Holy Spirit: you must turn at God's reproof.

People don't reject the truth because it is false; they reject it because it is uncomfortable, and black and Latino people hate the discomfort of change. You cannot change your condition if you won't change yourself. Everything you learn just sits there and becomes nothing, like people who know what to do to lose weight and won't do a damn thing.

Christ said the same thing: “If ye love me, keep my commandments. And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter.” The Comforter comes to those who keep the commandments. All these Christians who say they have the Holy Spirit and won't keep the commandments have Satan on them.

Who is that Comforter? “Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him.” “I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.” Christ is the Comforter. It is not Muhammad. Christ is the Holy Spirit.

Ye prisoners of hope: “By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison.” When Christ came he preached to the spirits in prison, and that is us, our mothers and fathers, our sons and daughters. We are in a spiritual prison. When Rome was dominating us, that was a prison; we did not have free rule.

“Which sometime were disobedient”: that is you and me. “When once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.”

“The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound.” We are in a prison house, and we are bound in sin. This is the prison the prisoners of hope are brought out of.

“And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” They answered, “We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?” They knew being made free meant being bound in bondage, and they said they were never slaves.

“Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.” They could not see that Rome was over them, paying taxes to Rome; they were oblivious because they were rich and wealthy. So Christ took it down a level: you are bound in your sins.

“Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.” Reign means rule: don't let sin rule within you. “Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.”

Our bodies must be vessels of righteousness, used for the commandments of God, nothing else. That is how the prisoners of hope come out of the prison of sin.

“I will render double unto thee”: “For your shame ye shall have double.” The shame we have suffered in captivity after captivity, we shall have double. “And for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion”: we are a confused people; look at TikTok and Instagram. “Therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.”

Watch the double: “And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.” We have never experienced that. Imagine walking down the street and everybody knows your children's names and moves out of their way and bows: that's brother so-and-so's kid. That is the double God is going to give us.

sense.text:
“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased!” America is the oppressor. America is the wicked, the king of Babylon, Lucifer.

America has 800 military bases around the world, uses its veto at the United Nations against the interests of humanity, has let every nuclear weapons treaty expire, and claims the right to do and control whatever it wants. Every accusation is a confession: it is the United States committing acts of evil in the world. This very week, at the United Nations vote on whether slavery was the worst crime ever done on the earth, America and Israel voted against it. They know nothing about justice or doing good for the people of the earth.

“In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan.” Speaking the language of Canaan is speaking the holy scriptures, the holy tongue, the word of God. This chapter uses the name Egypt, but this is spiritual Egypt, America the bully of the earth, the oppressive city. There will be civil war here and destruction here: “one shall be called, The city of destruction.” Whether that is New York or Washington, D.C., we don't know, but it is going to be a major city.

And don't think America are the good guys. The movie Argo shows how, in 1953, America overthrew the elected ruler of Iran by a coup and put in the Shah; how the people hated him and revolted in the '70s, took the embassy, and said the Americans in it were spies; and how everybody in the embassy burned the records. If they were not spies, why burn everything? That is the history behind what is going on over there today.
“In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt”: the sacrifice of Israelites. “And a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord.”

“For they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors.” The Israelites shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors, who are going to be on our necks for teaching the gospel. “And he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them”: the Lord shall send Christ, and he shall deliver us.

precepts.why:
“Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom”: hear the word of God, the Bible; God has many things against Edom. “And his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman”: Teman is another name for Edom.

“Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out.” All the problems are centered around the least of the flock, and the least of the flock is the land of Israel. On the map the Arab world is all green, and Israel is a tiny speck in the middle. That tiny land shall draw out Babylon and all nations to fight. “Surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them”: God will make where they live desolate.

Joel says the same thing as Isaiah 19, in different words. “Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them”: spare them because of the oppressors. “Wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?” That is what the oppressors are going to say to us.

“Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people.” His people are not in the land; they are in two different areas. “Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil”: blessings. “And I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen.”

This is what we wanted to get to: “But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate.” That land is the land of Israel. “With his face toward the east sea”: the Dead Sea. “And his hinder part toward the utmost sea”: the Mediterranean. “And his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.” It is the same thing Isaiah 19 says: the oppressor is driven out and God delivers his people.

sense.text: “Thus saith the Lord God; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.” In the midst means in the middle. Jerusalem is the center of all nations, the center of the world. That is what the Bible is talking about, and it is why the prophecies of the nations are reckoned from Israel as the center: north, south, east and west.

“Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots.” According to prophecy the Arabs will attack first. Right now it is Iran fighting, so we know this is not the end yet; the tribulation hasn't even come. There is going to come a time when the Arabs get rid of their own leaders, the crown princes, who care only about money, wine and women. The Arabs are going to get rid of the crown princes, them damn coons, if they don't change.

“And the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.”

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood”: the Carmanians are the Iranians. That is what Iran is waiting for: right now Iran is on its own, and once the Arabs go first, Iran is coming right behind them. When they were killing Iran's leaders everybody said Iran was finished, but Iran was holding back, saying wait, with its stockpiles.

“And with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” The land of the Assyrians is a metaphor: they are coming against the Israelis.

“And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature.” The Arabs and the Carmanians conspire together “in great power to persecute them”, the Israelis in that land. They “shall flee”, and “from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them, and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.”

“Behold clouds from the east and from the north unto the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and storm.” Reckon the directions with Israel as the center, as Ezekiel 5:5 says. North: Turkey, Greece, Bulgaria, Romania, Serbia, Hungary, Slovakia, Poland, Ukraine, Belarus. South: Egypt, Libya, Tunisia, Algeria, Malta, Italy, Cyprus. East: Syria, Jordan, Iraq, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Afghanistan, India, China, Japan. West: France, Britain, and the USA to the northwest across the Atlantic.

“They shall smite one upon another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star”: missiles. “And blood shall be from the sword unto the belly”, and “there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth.”

“And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west.” Verse 34 named the east, the north and the south; here it adds the west: France, Britain and America. As Jeremiah 49 and Joel 2 showed, something is going to happen and America is going to come to the rescue.

“And strong winds shall arise from the east, and shall open it”: open the silos. “The star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind” is an ICBM, and they probably have worse than that. They “shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star”: this is no regular missile, it is a horrible star. “Fire, and hail, and flying swords”: the flying swords are the ballistic missiles, the conventional ones.
“And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.” These missiles break down cities and walls.
“And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” Babylon is America. He is about to make America great again; God says he is going to make you afraid again.

“They shall come to her, and besiege her.” The nations, particularly NATO, are going to besiege America; it is not going to be a one-on-one thing. “The star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her: then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.”
“And they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear”: prisoners of war. And after the fall of Babylon, the party is not over; we go back to Zechariah 9.

precepts.why: Before the Arabs come out, so you know what is meant: “For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another; they shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.” Sedition is insurrection against the government. They will not regard their kings nor princes: the people are going to get rid of the crown princes, all of them, and then the nations of the dragons of Arabia come out.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning, Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.”

This is the same moment as 2 Esdras 15:44, when the dust and smoke of Babylon go up and all that are about her bewail her. Babylon is America.

sense.text: After the fall of Babylon, what happens? “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee.”

“When I have bent Judah for me”: God bends the tribe of Judah into a weapon of war. “Filled the bow with Ephraim”: he makes the tribe of Ephraim into a bow. “And raised up thy sons, O Zion”: the rest of the ten tribes of Israel. “Against thy sons, O Greece”: against the rest of the European nations. “And made thee as the sword of a mighty man”: he is going to transform us into the sword of a mighty man.

“And the Lord shall be seen over them”: this is how you know it is that day, because the Lord shall be seen over us; there will be no guessing that day. “His arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south”, the chariots of God.

“The Lord of hosts shall defend them”: God shall defend us. “And they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones”: we shall devour the nations. “And they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine”: we are going to party.
“And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.”

“For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful”: the brothers are going to be rejoicing. “And new wine the maids”: and the sisters are going to be joyful too. Praise the Lord. Twelve tribes.
